name: Grand Hyatt Tampa Bay
positioning: Waterfront Grand Hyatt on 35 acres by Tampa Bay, with a nature preserve, trails, two pools, villa-style casitas and bay-view suites
best_for: Travelers who want a waterfront stay in Tampa with nature trails, a dock and outdoor sports
Guests who like villa-style casitas or bay-view suites

facts.text: The hotel's 35-acre nature preserve is the backdrop to its pools.
Guests can take in sunset views along the hotel's dock and at its firepits.
The hotel connects to several hiking and biking trails that run along the water's edge.
Sports on the property include tennis and pickleball.
Rooms are coastal-inspired, and many have water or city views.
The Bay View Suite offers views of the bay and is on floors 10 to 12.
The Grand Residence is a two-story loft-style villa with a full kitchen and a large patio.
The hotel is pet-friendly, with dog-friendly rooms in the casitas.
Oystercatchers overlooks Tampa Bay and serves fresh, local seafood.
1823 Kitchen & Bar is on the lobby level and is named for the year Tampa was settled.

highlights.text: The hotel is set on 35 waterfront acres near Tampa International Airport, with wildlife views and two pools.
Guests can ride a bicycle on a 9.5-mile scenic trail or walk the nature trail on the property.
The Rooftop Sunset Experience takes place on the 14th-floor Skylark Terrace, with firepits, plush seating and views.
The Casita Suite is a two-story, loft-style villa with a full bathroom on each floor and a patio.
Guests can rent a private daybed by the waterfront with poolside service.

considerations.text: The hotel is near Tampa International Airport, and some rooms look out on the airport runways.
The casitas are a five-minute walk from the main tower, near the bayside pool and Oystercatchers.
WhataHotel notes a business-oriented atmosphere that may feel formal for leisure travelers.
